executiveSummary.headline: Clarify In-Terminal Access and Airport-Shuttle Language
executiveSummary.lead: Tampa Airport Marriott has a highly distinctive in-terminal proposition, renovated rooms, day-use inventory, three restaurants, an outdoor pool, and renovated event venues, yet it appeared in only 6.5% of eligible scenarios and 2.2% of comparable consideration answers. The immediate work is factual: resolve airport-access and shuttle wording, reconcile event-space totals, and consistently present verified layover, dining, and meeting assets.
executiveSummary.metricsNote: AI Consideration is the share of comparable monitored answers mentioning the hotel; Scenario Presence is the share of eligible traveler-need scenarios where it appeared. Certified Peer Position uses only the named certified Marriott Bonvoy set. These measures do not represent bookings, ADR, revenue, or traveler exposure.

themes.title: Clarify In-Terminal Access and Airport-Shuttle Language
themes.what: The overview describes the hotel as inside TPA with direct terminal access. The getting-here section includes an on-request $0 round trip, another line says the hotel does not provide shuttle service, and the FAQ says an airport shuttle is available.
themes.whyItMatters: Travelers need to know whether they walk from the terminal or use a vehicle; ambiguous shuttle language weakens the hotel's defining access advantage.

themes.title: Reconcile Renovated Event-Space Totals
themes.what: The overview states 25,416 square feet, events marketing says 25,000 square feet, and the events summary reports 25,766 square feet across 17 event rooms with capacity of 700.
themes.whyItMatters: Rounding may explain one difference, but the 350-square-foot variance between precise totals requires a signed inventory basis.

themes.title: Make Layover, Dining, Pool, and Rooftop Assets Usable
themes.what: Marriott verifies renovated soundproof rooms, day-use rooms, Imbarco, Kahwa Coffee, in-room dining, outdoor pool, 24-hour fitness, and rooftop event space. ADP recorded 0% restaurant, room-service, airport-adjacent, and ballroom-capacity recognition.
themes.whyItMatters: These facts distinguish the property for disrupted travel, layovers, meetings, and airport stays, but the audit does not claim content caused the measured result.

actionsResearchRecord.headline: Clarify In-Terminal Access and Airport-Shuttle Language
actionsResearchRecord.priorityWhy: The core airport proposition is presented with conflicting transport language on the same official page.
actionsResearchRecord.whatWeFound: The overview describes the hotel as inside TPA with direct terminal access. The getting-here section includes an on-request $0 round trip, another line says the hotel does not provide shuttle service, and the FAQ says an airport shuttle is available.
actionsResearchRecord.whyItMatters: Travelers need to know whether they walk from the terminal or use a vehicle; ambiguous shuttle language weakens the hotel's defining access advantage.
recommendedSteps: Operations confirms the actual TPA arrival path and any vehicle service.
Define when “in-terminal,” “direct access,” and “airport shuttle” each apply.
Align overview, transportation fields, FAQ, and booking disclosures.
Verify the live mobile and desktop journey.
actionsResearchRecord.suggestedTimeframe: Review in 2 weeks; approved updates within 30–45 days
actionsResearchRecord.timeframeNote: Timing is proposed and requires accountable-owner agreement.

actionsResearchRecord.headline: Reconcile Renovated Event-Space Totals
actionsResearchRecord.priorityWhy: Official Marriott content uses three different headline totals.
actionsResearchRecord.whatWeFound: The overview states 25,416 square feet, events marketing says 25,000 square feet, and the events summary reports 25,766 square feet across 17 event rooms with capacity of 700.
actionsResearchRecord.whyItMatters: Rounding may explain one difference, but the 350-square-foot variance between precise totals requires a signed inventory basis.
recommendedSteps: Sign the current room-by-room inventory after renovation.
Define indoor, outdoor, rooftop, and divisible-space inclusion.
Align precise totals and label rounded marketing totals.
Verify planner guides, overview, events, and floor plans.
actionsResearchRecord.suggestedTimeframe: Review in 2 weeks; approved updates within 30–45 days
actionsResearchRecord.timeframeNote: Timing is proposed and requires accountable-owner agreement.

actionsResearchRecord.headline: Make Layover, Dining, Pool, and Rooftop Assets Usable
actionsResearchRecord.priorityWhy: ADP consideration is 2.2% despite verified airport-specific and renovated assets.
actionsResearchRecord.whatWeFound: Marriott verifies renovated soundproof rooms, day-use rooms, Imbarco, Kahwa Coffee, in-room dining, outdoor pool, 24-hour fitness, and rooftop event space. ADP recorded 0% restaurant, room-service, airport-adjacent, and ballroom-capacity recognition.
actionsResearchRecord.whyItMatters: These facts distinguish the property for disrupted travel, layovers, meetings, and airport stays, but the audit does not claim content caused the measured result.
recommendedSteps: Approve current renovated-room, day-use, outlet, pool, and rooftop facts.
Map each fact to its highest-intent official page and structured field.
Keep temporary offers separate from evergreen property facts.
QA inquiry and booking paths.
actionsResearchRecord.suggestedTimeframe: Review in 2 weeks; approved updates within 30–45 days
actionsResearchRecord.timeframeNote: Timing is proposed and requires accountable-owner agreement.

actionsResearchRecord.headline: Confirm and align official facts for Tampa Airport Marriott

actionsResearchRecord.whatWeFound: Confirm that meetings, dining, and amenities facts on the official page match the hotel’s approved source of truth; align third-party listings after confirmation.
actionsResearchRecord.whyItMatters: Digital content readiness depends on one approved source of truth before third-party outreach.
recommendedSteps: Establish one approved fact sheet; update the official page first; then cascade to GBP/OTAs when values are confirmed.
Do not change unconfirmed values on OTAs until the hotel approves the fact sheet.
